text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without uttering a single word, Mejiro 
Ramonu silently prepared to leave the 
room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, she appears calm and 
unfazed by the race results, but—
choice_data_list: It was a race that leads to the next one

(Isn't this really painful for her after 
all?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She left the waiting room just like that. 
Perhaps it's best to leave her alone for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Next time—... I'll hold on tight and 
never let go."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for a tragic heroine, 
would you mind searching elsewhere?
choice_data_list: I didn't mean it that way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What we must look towards is what comes 
next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Were those words a reminder to herself, or 
were they directed at me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I felt a sense of bracing 
resolve.
